Pakistan equalled India's famous record against England in the 2002 NatWest Series final at Lord's.

items.title: FIA issues a formal warning to F1 driver Isack Hadjar after paddock push
items.author: CARLOS RODRÍGUEZ
items.description: MEXICO CITY (AP) — Red Bull driver Isack Hadjar received a formal warning from the governing body of Formula 1 on Saturday after pushing a fan in the paddock area before a practice session at the Mexico City Grand Prix.Footage on social media shows Hadjar using his right hand to push away an adult man who attempted to hug him and take a selfie.

items.title: Ballack chides Bayern bosses for criticism of teenager Karl
items.description: Former Bayern Munich star Michael Ballack, who is now the agent of Lennart Karl, believes the club's hierarchy has been too harsh on his teenage client. Honorary president Uli Hoeness said the 18-year-old needed to show a bit more "humility" after struggling so far this term after breaking into the Bayern and Germany set-up last season.
